en.name: Marshmallow crème
en.summary: An unopened jar of marshmallow crème keeps 2–5 months from purchase in the cupboard, and about 1 month once opened. It is a sugar-and-egg-white foam, so it fails by drying, weeping and crystallising rather than by anything growing in it.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark, 2–5 months from purchase unopened and about 1 month after opening, with the lid screwed down hard. Marshmallow crème is mostly sugar and corn syrup whipped with egg white or gelatine, and the sugar concentration is what keeps it stable at room temperature — but it is a foam, and a foam is mostly surface. Once air gets at it the top layer stiffens into a crust, the jar weeps a thin syrup, and the whole thing gradually collapses and grains up. Keep it away from the hob; warmth makes it run and separate.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is not required and does not help. Cold makes the crème set stiff and almost impossible to scoop, and it encourages the sugar to crystallise into a grainy texture once you warm it again. Keep the jar in the cupboard and work to the opened figure instead. If a jar has gone solid because the kitchen is cold, leave it somewhere warmer for an hour rather than microwaving it, which turns marshmallow crème into hot glue very quickly.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for marshmallow crème and freezing it is counterproductive. The foam structure does not survive the freeze — it collapses and thaws to a sticky, weeping syrup with the whipped texture gone — and there is nothing to gain, because the jar is shelf-stable as it is. If you have too much, fold it into a fudge or a frosting rather than trying to store it cold.
spoilage: Mould, usually a spot on the surface or around the rim from a used knife.
A hard crust on top with thin syrup weeping underneath.
A grainy, crystalline texture instead of a smooth gloss.
A fermented or sour smell instead of a clean vanilla-sugar one.
tips: Always use a clean dry spoon; crumbs and moisture are what spoil a jar.
Wipe the rim before screwing the lid back on.
Press a piece of cling film onto the surface if you will not finish the jar soon.
Warm a stiff jar in a warm room, not in the microwave.

faq.q: How long does marshmallow crème last after opening?
faq.a: About 1 month in the cupboard with the lid tight. Unopened it keeps 2–5 months from purchase.
No. Cold makes it stiff and grainy. Keep it in a cool dry cupboard instead.
It is not worth doing: the foam collapses and thaws to a weeping syrup.

zh.name: 棉花糖醬
zh.summary: 未開封的棉花糖醬從購買日起算放櫥櫃 2～5 個月，開封後約 1 個月。它是糖與蛋白打成的泡沫，壞掉的方式是變乾、出水、結砂，而不是長出什麼東西。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光：未開封自購買日起 2～5 個月，開封後約 1 個月，蓋子要旋緊。棉花糖醬主要是糖和玉米糖漿與蛋白（或明膠）打發而成，糖的濃度就是它能常溫存放的理由——但它是泡沫，而泡沫幾乎全是表面積。一旦接觸空氣，上層會結成硬殼，罐子開始滲出稀糖漿，整體慢慢塌陷、變砂。也請遠離爐台，溫度會讓它變稀、分離。
zh.fridge: 不需要冷藏，冷藏也沒有幫助。低溫會讓它凝得死硬、幾乎挖不動，回溫之後還容易結晶變砂。請放櫥櫃，並以開封後的期限為準。如果因為天氣冷而變硬，把罐子放到溫暖的地方一小時就好，不要微波——棉花糖醬微波幾秒就會變成熱膠。
zh.freezer: 棉花糖醬沒有公布的冷凍期限，冷凍也只會適得其反。泡沫結構撐不過結冰，解凍後會塌成黏答答、會出水的糖漿，打發的質地完全消失；而且也沒好處，它本來就能常溫存放。真的太多，就拿去做牛軋糖類的糖果或抹面霜，不要想著冰起來。
spoilage: 長霉，通常是表面一小點或罐口，多半來自用過的刀。
表面結一層硬殼，底下滲出稀糖漿。
原本光滑有光澤的質地變得粗糙帶砂。
聞起來發酵或發酸，而不是乾淨的香草甜味。
tips: 一定要用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，屑屑和水分才是罪魁禍首。
旋回蓋子之前先把罐口擦乾淨。
短期內吃不完，就在表面壓一層保鮮膜。
變硬就放到溫暖的房間回溫，不要微波。

faq.q: 棉花糖醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放櫥櫃約 1 個月。未開封則是自購買日起 2～5 個月。
不用。低溫會讓它變硬變砂，請放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃。
不值得：泡沫會塌掉，解凍後變成會出水的黏糖漿。
